mainTopic: The משנה on an animal whose legs were cut off or broken, which ארכובה (leg joint) is meant, and the exact definition of צומת הגידין.
overview: The משנה teaches that if an animal's leg is cut off below the ארכובה (leg joint), it stays כשרה, but a cut above it makes it a טרפה. The same is true if the צומת הגידין, the place where the leg sinews come together, is removed. If a bone breaks but the limb still hangs on, the question is whether most of the flesh around the break is intact. The גמרא asks which joint the משנה means: רבי חייא says the lower joint, sold with the head, and עולא in the name of רבי אושעיא says the upper joint, which sticks out on a camel. עולא challenges רב יהודה on why the משנה mentions צומת הגידין, and רב יהודה's answers fail because of the משנה's exact wording. רב פפא gives a different version of the discussion in which everyone agrees on the upper joint, and רב אשי teaches that טרפות cannot be compared to one another by logic. The גמרא then defines exactly where צומת הגידין is. It brings several opinions, including שמואל's rule: from where the sinews bunch together until where they spread out. אביי gives the size: four טפחים in an ox. He also gives signs that hold for every animal: sinews that stick out and are hard, thick and white are included.

steps.title: Legs cut off below or above the joint, and the cord of sinews
steps.stepSummary: The משנה rules that a leg cut off below the ארכובה leaves the animal כשרה, a cut above it makes it a טריפה, and removing the צומת הגידין also makes it a טריפה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If an animal's legs were cut off from the knee joint and below, it is kosher. From the knee joint and above, it is not kosher. The same applies if its cord of sinews was removed.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה lays down a rule for an animal that lost part of its leg: where the cut was made decides whether the animal is כשרה or a טריפה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ארכובה is the dividing line. Losing the lower part of the leg does not harm the animal's survival, so it stays כשרה. A cut higher up makes it a טריפה. The משנה adds a second case with the same ruling: an animal whose צומת הגידין (the place where the sinews come together in the leg) was removed.

keyTerms.meaning: A leg joint (knee or hock) of the animal
Invalid; here meaning a טריפה that is forbidden even after שחיטה
The place in the leg where the sinews come together

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up 'below' and 'above.' Losing the LOWER part of the leg is fine. Only a cut ABOVE the joint makes the animal a טריפה.

phrases.english: MISHNAH:
An animal whose legs were cut off:
phrases.notes: This is talking about the hind legs.

phrases.english: from the leg joint and below, it is kosher;
from the leg joint and above, it is invalid (a טריפה);
and likewise one whose convergence of sinews was removed.

steps.triggerLanguage: בְּהֵמָה שֶׁנֶּחְתְּכוּ רַגְלֶיהָ מִן הָאַרְכּוּבָּה וּלְמַטָּה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A leg cut off below the ארכובה leaves the animal כשרה. A cut above it, or removal of the צומת הגידין, makes it a טריפה.

steps.title: A broken bone: does the slaughter cover the limb?
steps.stepSummary: If a limb's bone broke but most of the surrounding flesh is intact, the שחיטה makes the limb pure. If not, the שחיטה does not.
steps.simpleTranslation: If the bone broke: if most of the flesh is still intact, its slaughter makes it pure. If not, its slaughter does not make it pure.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה moves to a new case: a leg whose bone snapped but which still hangs on the animal.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The test is the flesh around the break. If most of it is intact, the limb still counts as part of the animal, so the שחיטה makes it pure along with the rest. If most of the flesh is gone, the limb is treated as already separated, and the שחיטה does not help it.

keyTerms.meaning: Most of the flesh is still intact
Its slaughter makes it pure, taking it out of the status of נבלה

steps.whatToRemember: For a broken bone, the deciding factor is the flesh, not the bone: is most of the flesh around the break still in place?

phrases.english: If the bone broke,
if most of the flesh is intact,
its slaughter makes it pure;
phrases.notes: Literally 'purifies it.' The broken limb counts as slaughtered along with the animal, so it is not treated as נבלה.

phrases.english: but if not,
its slaughter does not make it pure.

steps.triggerLanguage: נִשְׁבַּר הָעֶצֶם אִם רוֹב הַבָּשָׂר קַיָּים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second case of the same משנה: a limb that is broken but not fully cut off.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If most of the flesh around the break is intact, the שחיטה makes the limb pure. Otherwise it does not.

steps.title: What 'below' and 'above' mean
steps.stepSummary: רבי חייא explains that the משנה's 'below' means below the joint and 'above' means above the joint.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יהודה said in the name of רב, in the name of רבי חייא: 'Below' means below the joint; 'above' means above the joint.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins by explaining the משנה's words through a chain of teachers going back to רבי חייא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה said 'from the joint and below' and 'from the joint and above.' רבי חייא makes clear that these phrases describe where the cut was: under the joint or over the joint. This sets up the next question: which joint is meant?

keyTerms.meaning: The Talmud's discussion of the משנה

phrases.english: GEMARA:
Rav Yehuda said that Rav said
that Rabbi Chiya said:
'Below' means below the leg joint;
'above' means above the leg joint.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא by explaining the wording of the משנה's first case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: 'Below' and 'above' in the משנה mean below the joint and above the joint.

steps.title: Which joint is the משנה talking about?
steps.stepSummary: Continuing his teaching, רבי חייא asks which of the leg's joints the משנה means.
steps.simpleTranslation: Regarding which leg joint did they say this?
steps.whatsHappening: This line sets up the next move. A leg has more than one joint, so רבי חייא asks which one is the dividing line.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A hind leg has an upper joint and a lower joint. Which one is meant changes the halacha: the higher the joint, the more of the leg can be lost while the animal stays כשרה.

phrases.english: Regarding which leg joint did they say this?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds on step 3: now that 'below' and 'above' are clear, which joint is meant?
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which of the leg's joints is the ארכובה that the משנה uses as its dividing line.

steps.title: The joint sold with the head
steps.stepSummary: רבי חייא answers that it is the joint sold together with the head, the lower joint.
steps.simpleTranslation: The leg joint that is sold together with the head.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי חייא answers his own question: the dividing line is the lower joint, which butchers sold along with the head.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Butchers sold the lower part of the leg together with the head, so everyone knew which joint that was. By this view, the animal is a טריפה only if the cut is above that lower joint, in the middle or upper part of the leg.

keyTerms.meaning: That is sold together with the head

phrases.english: Regarding the leg joint
that is sold together with the head.
phrases.notes: The lower part of the leg was sold with the head, so this means the lower joint.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 4.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The ארכובה of the משנה is the lower joint, the one sold together with the head.

steps.title: A second view: the joint that stands out on a camel
steps.stepSummary: עולא in the name of רבי אושעיא says the joint meant is the one whose matching joint on a camel is easy to see, the upper joint.
steps.simpleTranslation: עולא said in the name of רבי אושעיא: It is the joint whose counterpart on a camel is clearly visible.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second opinion that disagrees with רבי חייא about which joint the משנה means.
steps.deeperAnalysis: On most animals this joint is hidden inside the body, but on a camel's long legs the matching joint sticks out clearly. This is the higher joint, between the thigh and the shin. By this view, the animal stays כשרה unless the cut is above that higher joint, which is a more lenient position than רבי חייא's.
steps.whatToRemember: There are two views on which ארכובה is meant. רבי חייא says the lower joint, sold with the head. רבי אושעיא says the upper joint, the one that stands out on a camel.
steps.whyThisMatters: The choice of joint decides how much of a leg an animal can lose and still be כשרה. This makes it a practical question for the laws of טריפות.

phrases.english: Ulla said that Rabbi Oshaya said:
It is the joint whose counterpart on a camel is noticeable.
phrases.notes: On a camel's long legs this joint sticks out, while on other animals it's hidden. So he means the upper joint.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a different answer to the question of step 4, disagreeing with רבי חייא in step 5.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The ארכובה of the משנה is the upper joint, whose matching joint on a camel is clearly visible.

steps.title: עולא asks why the משנה mentions the convergence of sinews
steps.stepSummary: עולא argues that his upper-joint reading explains the משנה's extra line about צומת הגידין, but רב יהודה's lower-joint reading makes that line seem unnecessary.
steps.simpleTranslation: עולא said to רב יהודה: My view, that the joint is the upper one whose match on a camel is easy to see, explains why the משנה adds 'and likewise if צומת הגידין was removed.' But according to you, why does the משנה need that line?
steps.whatsHappening: עולא attacks רב יהודה, who says the משנה's joint is the lower joint. He argues that this view leaves the line about צומת הגידין with no purpose.
steps.deeperAnalysis: צומת הגידין sits on the middle bone, between the two joints. According to עולא, a cut in the middle bone is kosher, so the משנה must tell us that removing צומת הגידין is still טריפה. According to רב יהודה, any cut above the lower joint, which includes the middle bone, is already טריפה, so the extra line seems to add nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: Granted, it works well (for one side, but not the other)
The place where the leg sinews come together, on the middle bone of the leg

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two joints. עולא means the upper joint and רב יהודה means the lower joint. צומת הגידין is on the bone between them.

phrases.english: Ulla said to Rav Yehuda:
Granted, according to me,
since I say it is the joint whose match on a camel is easy to see,
that is why it teaches:
"And likewise, one whose convergence of sinews was removed."
But according to you,
what is "and likewise, one whose convergence of sinews was removed" for?

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְדִידִי דְּאָמֵינָא כְּנֶגְדּוֹ בְּגָמָל נִיכָּר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: עולא uses his own reading from step 6 to attack the lower-joint reading.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that the משנה's joint is the lower joint.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If a cut anywhere above the lower joint is already טריפה, the משנה's separate line about צומת הגידין becomes redundant.

steps.title: רב יהודה says the משנה teaches two separate cases
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה answers that the משנה describes two separate cases: a cut above the joint that does not touch צומת הגידין, and removal of צומת הגידין with no cut above the joint.
steps.simpleTranslation: He answered: one case is the joint without צומת הגידין, and the other is צומת הגידין without the joint.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יהודה defends himself. He says the extra line is not repeating anything because it describes a different case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first part of the משנה covers a cut above the lower joint that misses צומת הגידין. The extra line covers damage to צומת הגידין alone. Each line teaches its own case, so neither one is redundant.

keyTerms.meaning: The leg joint (the same word as אַרְכּוּבָּה)
The second case: only צומת הגידין was damaged, with no cut above the joint

phrases.english: He said to him:
The joint without the convergence of sinews,
phrases.notes: He means a cut above the lower joint that doesn't reach the sinews spot.

phrases.english: and the convergence of sinews without the joint.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers עולא's challenge by splitting the משנה into two separate cases.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The line about צומת הגידין repeats what the first part already covers.
steps.terutzMaskana: Each line covers a different kind of damage.

steps.title: עולא points to the word 'were cut' and רב יהודה falls silent
steps.stepSummary: עולא objects that the משנה says 'were cut,' meaning a full cut above the joint. Such a cut would include צומת הגידין, so the two cases cannot be separated. רב יהודה has no answer.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the משנה says 'were cut'! רב יהודה was silent.
steps.whatsHappening: עולא pushes back using the exact wording of the משנה. רב יהודה cannot answer and stays quiet.
steps.deeperAnalysis: 'Were cut' from the joint and up describes the whole leg being cut off above the joint. That kind of cut would necessarily include the sinews spot. So the משנה's first case cannot be 'the joint without צומת הגידין,' and רב יהודה's split falls apart.

keyTerms.meaning: But it teaches (introduces a challenge from the source's own wording)
He was silent (he had no answer)

phrases.english: But it teaches "were cut"!
phrases.notes: A full cut above the joint would have to include the sinews spot.

phrases.english: He was silent.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the two-case answer from step 8, and the attack is left standing.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: 'Were cut' means a complete cut, which cannot leave out צומת הגידין.

steps.title: Afterward, רב יהודה thinks of a better answer
steps.stepSummary: After עולא leaves, רב יהודה wonders why he did not say that 'below' means below the lower joint, while 'above' means above צומת הגידין.
steps.simpleTranslation: After עולא left, רב יהודה said: Why didn't I tell him that 'below' means below the joint, and 'above' means above צומת הגידין?
steps.whatsHappening: Speaking to himself, רב יהודה comes up with a new answer that he could have given עולא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If 'above' starts only above צומת הגידין, then the area between the lower joint and the sinews spot is not covered by the first part of the משנה. That would make the line about צומת הגידין necessary, since it teaches that damage to that spot is טריפה.

phrases.english: After he left, he said:
phrases.notes: עולא is the one who left. רב יהודה is the one speaking.

phrases.english: Why did I not say to him:
"Below" means below the joint,
"above" means above the convergence of sinews?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a new answer to עולא's original challenge after the first answer failed.
steps.terutzMaskana: 'Above' begins only above צומת הגידין, so the extra line is needed.

steps.title: רב יהודה realizes the new answer would also fail
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה rejects his own idea. Just as עולא pointed to 'were cut,' he would point to the words 'from the joint and above,' which begin right at the joint.
steps.simpleTranslation: Then he said: When I gave him an answer, didn't he reply that the משנה says 'were cut'? Here too, he would say the משנה says 'from the joint and above.'
steps.whatsHappening: רב יהודה realizes that עולא would have knocked down this answer too, using the exact words of the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says 'from the joint and above,' so 'above' begins right at the joint and not above the sinews spot. That covers the whole middle bone, including צומת הגידין. עולא's challenge is left without an answer.

keyTerms.meaning: He then said (taking back what he just said)

steps.whatToRemember: עולא's question stands: on the lower-joint reading, it is hard to explain why the משנה mentions צומת הגידין. Both of רב יהודה's answers fail because of the משנה's exact wording.

phrases.english: He then said:
Did I not say an answer to him, and he said to me:
"It teaches 'were cut'"?
Here too,
phrases.notes: He means עולא would have answered this the same way.

phrases.english: it teaches "from the joint and above."

steps.triggerLanguage: הֲדַר אָמַר וְלָא אֲמַרִי לֵיהּ וַאֲמַר לִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the new answer from step 10.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The rereading of 'above' as starting above צומת הגידין.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The משנה's words 'from the joint and above' mean that 'above' begins right at the joint.

steps.title: רב פפא's version of רב יהודה's teaching
steps.stepSummary: רב פפא reports רב יהודה's teaching differently. Below means below both the joint and צומת הגידין. Above means above both. The middle area is a טרפה only if צומת הגידין was removed. The ארכובה is the upper joint, like עולא.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב פפא teaches it this way: רב יהודה said in the name of רב, in the name of רבי חייא: 'Below' means below the ארכובה and below צומת הגידין. 'Above' means above the ארכובה and above צומת הגידין. And the same is true where צומת הגידין was removed. The ארכובה itself is as עולא said in the name of רבי אושעיא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives a second version of the whole argument. In this version there is no fight between רב יהודה and עולא about which joint is the ארכובה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In this version רב יהודה accepts that the ארכובה is the upper joint, which is עולא's view. The משנה is read as three zones. A cut on the lower bone (below everything) is fine. A cut on the upper bone (above everything) makes it a טרפה. In the middle area, it is a טרפה only if צומת הגידין itself was removed.

keyTerms.meaning: Teaches it like this (gives a different version of the discussion)
The leg joint (knee joint) of the animal
The place where the sinews of the leg meet together

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new argument. It is a different version of the whole earlier debate, and in it the earlier disagreement about which joint is meant disappears.

phrases.english: Rav Pappa teaches it like this:

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא:
phrases.english: Rav Yehuda said that Rav said that Rabbi Chiya said:
'Below' means below the leg joint and below the meeting point of the sinews,
'Above' means above the leg joint and above the meeting point of the sinews,
and also where the meeting point of the sinews was removed.
phrases.notes: This is the middle area. There it is a טרפה only if the sinews themselves were taken out.

phrases.english: And the leg joint itself
is as Ulla said in the name of Rabbi Oshaya.
phrases.notes: This means the upper joint, the one that stands out on a camel's leg.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a different version of the whole debate in steps 7-11, in which רב יהודה agrees with עולא.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Below both the joint and צומת הגידין is kosher. Above both is a טרפה. In between, it is a טרפה only if צומת הגידין was removed. The ארכובה is the upper joint.
steps.whyThisMatters: This version removes the dispute about the joint and sets up the question in the next step.

steps.title: How can a higher cut be safe but a lower cut deadly?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks: according to this version, cutting higher in the middle area (above the sinews) leaves the animal alive, while cutting lower, on the sinews, makes it die. Does that make sense?
steps.simpleTranslation: Is there really such a thing, that if one goes up and cuts it, it lives, but if one goes down and cuts it, it dies?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks רב פפא's version with a logic question about where the cut is made.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the middle area, a cut above צומת הגידין does not make it a טרפה, but removing צומת הגידין, which is lower, does. That seems backwards, because a higher cut takes off more of the leg and should be worse. So the reading looks strange.

phrases.english: But is there really such a thing,
that if one goes higher and cuts it, it lives,
but if one goes lower and cuts it, it dies?
phrases.notes: 'Dies' here means it is a טרפה, an animal that will not survive.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the result of רב פפא's version.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב פפא's version, where a cut above צומת הגידין is kosher but removing צומת הגידין is a טרפה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Logically, a higher cut removes more of the leg and should be at least as dangerous as a lower one.

steps.title: טרפות cannot be compared to each other
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי answers that you cannot use logic to compare one טרפה with another. Cutting in one place can kill, and cutting in another place can be survivable.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי said: Are you comparing טרפות to each other? We do not say about טרפות that this one is like that one. You can cut it in one place and it dies, and cut it in another place and it lives.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי answers the question by saying it was based on a wrong assumption.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question assumed that a higher cut must be at least as bad as a lower one. רב אשי says טרפות do not work by that kind of logic. Each body part has its own rules, so a lower spot can be deadly while a higher spot is not.

keyTerms.meaning: Injuries or defects that make an animal unable to live, so it is forbidden to eat
This one is like that one

steps.whatToRemember: An important rule: אין אומרין בטרפות זו דומה לזו. You cannot work out one טרפה from another by logic.
steps.whyThisMatters: This general rule is used in many places when the laws of טרפות seem to go against common sense.

phrases.english: Rav Ashi said:
Are you comparing tereifos to one another?

phrases.aramaic: אֵין אוֹמְרִין בִּטְרֵפוֹת זוֹ דּוֹמָה לָזוֹ,
phrases.english: We do not say with tereifos that this one is like that one,
for one can cut it here and it dies,
and cut it there and it lives.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in step 13.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rejects the assumption behind the question
steps.terutzHavaAmina: A higher cut should be at least as dangerous as a lower cut.
steps.terutzMaskana: Each place in the body has its own rules, so טרפות cannot be compared by logic.

steps.title: Which sinews count as the convergence of sinews?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks exactly which part of the sinews is called צומת הגידין.
steps.simpleTranslation: And which are צומת הגידין?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts a new topic. It asks for the exact location of צומת הגידין. This step sets up the answers that follow.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since the law depends on whether צומת הגידין was removed, we must know exactly which stretch of sinew it is. This is a question asking for a definition, not a challenge.

keyTerms.meaning: And which are they (asking for a definition)

phrases.english: And which are the meeting point of the sinews?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the logic question to defining a key term.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The exact location of צומת הגידין in the leg.

steps.title: Three opinions on where the sinews meet
steps.stepSummary: רבה, quoting רב אשי, says it is the part off the bone. רבה בר רב הונא, quoting רב אשי, says it is the part next to the bone. רבא son of רבה בר רב הונא, quoting רב אסי, says it starts even lower, above the ערקומא.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה said in the name of רב אשי: the part that is off the bone and outward. רבה בר רב הונא said in the name of רב אשי: the part on the bone and inward. רבא son of רבה בר רב הונא said in the name of רב אסי: the part above the ערקומא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives three answers to the question of where צומת הגידין is.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The sinews run along the bone, then leave the bone, then spread apart into the flesh. The first opinion puts צומת הגידין where they have left the bone but are still together. The second puts it where they lie on the bone. The third puts it lower still, above the small bone called ערקומא.

keyTerms.meaning: A small bone between the lower bone and the middle bone of the leg

steps.whatToRemember: There are three opinions on where צומת הגידין is: off the bone, on the bone, or even lower, above the ערקומא.

phrases.english: Rabba said that Rav Ashi said:
those from the bone and outward,
phrases.notes: He means the sinews after they leave the bone, before they spread apart.

phrases.aramaic: רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא אָמַר רַב אָשֵׁי:
phrases.english: Rabba bar Rav Huna said that Rav Ashi said:
those from the bone and inward,
phrases.notes: He means the sinews lying right against the bone.

phrases.aramaic: רָבָא בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא אָמַר רַב אַסִּי:
phrases.english: Rava, son of Rabba bar Rav Huna, said that Rav Asi said:
those that are above the arkuma.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבָּה אָמַר רַב אָשֵׁי: דְּאַגַּרְמָא וּלְבַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 15.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Three opinions: the sinews off the bone, the sinews on the bone, or the sinews above the ערקומא.

steps.title: A sage says the sinews of the ערקומא itself count
steps.stepSummary: A certain sage, sitting before רבי אבא, said that the צומת הגידין includes the sinews of the ערקומא bone itself.
steps.simpleTranslation: One of the sages sat before רבי אבא and said: it includes the sinews of the ערקומא itself.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tells a story about a sage who stretched the area of צומת הגידין even lower, down to the ערקומא itself. This sets up רבי אבא's reaction in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the last step, רב אסי said the area starts just above the ערקומא. This sage goes one step further and includes the ערקומא itself, which makes the area bigger and the law stricter.

keyTerms.meaning: A bone near the lower part of the animal's leg

phrases.aramaic: יָתֵיב הָהוּא מֵרַבָּנַן קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַבִּי אַבָּא,
phrases.english: A certain one of the Sages sat before Rabbi Abba,
and he sat and said:
Those of the arkum itself.
phrases.notes: He means the sinews right on the ערקומא bone also count as צומת הגידין.

steps.triggerLanguage: יָתֵיב הָהוּא מֵרַבָּנַן קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַבִּי אַבָּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Extends the location debate from step 16 to an even lower point.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The sinews of the ערקומא itself are part of צומת הגידין.

steps.title: רבי אבא rejects that view: it is where butchers cut
steps.stepSummary: רבי אבא tells his students not to listen to that sage, because רב יהודה said the spot is where butchers split open the leg.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אבא said: Don't listen to him. This is what רב יהודה said: it is where the butchers split the leg open.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אבא pushes back against the sage's opinion and gives the correct location in the name of רב יהודה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The sage made the area too big. רבי אבא says the area does not reach the ערקומא itself, only the place where butchers usually cut open the leg.

phrases.english: Rabbi Abba said:
Do not listen to him,
this is what Rav Yehuda said:
Where the butchers split open.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the opinion stated in step 17.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The claim that the ערקומא itself is included.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: It goes too far; רב יהודה placed it where butchers split the leg.

steps.title: This matches רב אסי's view
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא notes that רבי אבא's position is the same as what רבא son of רבה בר רב הונא said in the name of רב אסי.
steps.simpleTranslation: And this is the same as what רבא son of רבה בר רב הונא said in the name of רב אסי.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out that רבי אבא's view is not new. It is the same as the opinion quoted in the previous section.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 16, רב אסי said the area starts just above the ערקומא. The place where butchers split the leg is that same spot, so the two teachings agree.

keyTerms.meaning: And this is the same as

phrases.aramaic: וְהַיְינוּ רָבָא בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא
phrases.english: And this is what Rava son of Rabba bar Rav Huna
phrases.notes: This points back to step 16, where he said the area starts just above the ערקומא.

phrases.english: said in the name of Rav Asi.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהַיְינוּ רָבָא בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Shows that רבי אבא's location matches an opinion from step 16.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The spot where butchers split the leg is the same as רב אסי's 'above the ערקומא'.

steps.title: שמואל: it is where the sinews bunch together
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה quotes שמואל: the צומת הגידין in the משנה is the place where the sinews come together.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יהודה said in the name of שמואל: the צומת הגידין the חכמים spoke about is the place where the sinews come together.
steps.whatsHappening: A new teaching begins. שמואל explains the name צומת הגידין: it is the spot where the sinews bunch together.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier steps asked where on the leg it is. Here שמואל describes what it looks like: the sinews join and look like one unit. He does not yet say how long that stretch is.

keyTerms.meaning: The place where the leg sinews bunch together

phrases.english: Rav Yehuda said in the name of Shmuel:
The convergence of sinews that they spoke of
is the place where the sinews converge.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל צוֹמֶת הַגִּידִים שֶׁאָמְרוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new definition, this time based on how the sinews look.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: צומת הגידין is the spot where the sinews bunch together.

steps.title: How far does it go?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how far the area of צומת הגידין extends.
steps.simpleTranslation: And up to how far?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a follow-up question: where does this area end? This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שמואל said where it starts, at the point where the sinews join. He did not say where it stops, so the גמרא asks.

phrases.english: And until how far?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the end point of the area שמואל described.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Where the area of צומת הגידין ends.

steps.title: רב יעקב: from where they join until where they spread out
steps.stepSummary: רב יעקב reports that רב יהודה taught in שמואל's name that the area runs from where the sinews join until where they spread out.
steps.simpleTranslation: A sage named רב יעקב said: When we were in רב יהודה's school, he told us: Hear from me something I heard from a great man. Who? שמואל. The צומת הגידין is the place where the sinews come together, and it runs from where they come together until where they spread out.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יעקב answers the question by giving the full version of שמואל's teaching, which includes the end point.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now we have both ends: the area starts where the sinews bunch together and ends where they spread out into the flesh. Only that stretch counts as צומת הגידין.

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ הָהוּא מִדְּרַבָּנַן, וְרַב יַעֲקֹב שְׁמֵיהּ:
phrases.english: One of the Sages, whose name was Rav Ya'akov, said to him:

phrases.aramaic: כִּי הֲוֵינַן בֵּי רַב יְהוּדָה אֲמַר לַן:
phrases.english: When we were in the school of Rav Yehuda, he said to us:
Hear from me a matter
that I heard from a great man,
and who is he? Shmuel:
The convergence of sinews that they spoke of
is the place where the sinews converge,
and from the place where they converge until the place where they spread out.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ הָהוּא מִדְּרַבָּנַן וְרַב יַעֲקֹב שְׁמֵיהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question from step 21.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The area runs from where the sinews bunch together until where they spread out.

steps.title: How long is that in actual size?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how long the stretch between joining and spreading out is.
steps.simpleTranslation: And how much is it?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for a real measurement of this area. The answer comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Knowing the start and end points is helpful, but it is hard to see exactly where sinews spread out. So the גמרא wants a fixed size.

phrases.english: And how much?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for a measurement of the area defined in step 22.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The actual length of the צומת הגידין area.

steps.title: אביי: four טפחים in an ox
steps.stepSummary: אביי says that in an ox the area is four טפחים long.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: four טפחים in an ox.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי gives a fixed size for a large animal: four handbreadths.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For an ox, there is a clear measure. This answer covers only big animals, which leads to the next question about small ones.

phrases.english: Abaye said:
Four handbreadths in an ox.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 23.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: In an ox, the area is four טפחים long.

steps.title: What about a small animal?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what the measure is for a small animal like a sheep or goat.
steps.simpleTranslation: What about a small animal?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks how to measure the area in a small animal. This sets up אביי's answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Four טפחים fits an ox, but a sheep's leg is much smaller. So the same number cannot work.

phrases.english: In a small animal, what?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks how step 24's measure applies to small animals.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: How to define the area in a small animal.

steps.title: אביי: prominent sinews count, sunken ones do not
steps.stepSummary: אביי says there is no fixed size for small animals: as long as the sinews stick out they count, and once they sink into the flesh they do not.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: if they stick out, they are צומת הגידין. If they are sunken in, they are not צומת הגידין.
steps.whatsHappening: Instead of a number, אביי gives a sign you can see: sinews that stand out are included, and sinews sunk into the flesh are not.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This puts שמואל's 'until they spread out' into practice. The point where the sinews sink into the flesh is where they spread out, and that is where the area ends.

keyTerms.meaning: Sunken in, swallowed into the flesh

phrases.english: Abaye said:
Prominent ones are the convergence of sinews,
sunken ones are not the convergence of sinews.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי בְּלִיטִי הָווּ צוֹמֶת הַגִּידִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 25 with a visual sign instead of a measurement.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: In a small animal, sinews that stick out count, and sunken ones do not.

steps.title: More signs: hard, thick and white sinews count
steps.stepSummary: More signs are given: hard, thick and white sinews are part of צומת הגידין, while soft, thin and non-white ones are not.
steps.simpleTranslation: Hard ones are צומת הגידין, soft ones are not. Thick ones are צומת הגידין, thin ones are not. White ones are צומת הגידין, ones that are not white are not.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds three more pairs of signs for telling which sinews belong to צומת הגידין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each pair has a yes side and a no side. Hard, thick and white means it counts. Soft, thin and not white means it does not. These signs help you identify the area in real life.
steps.whatToRemember: צומת הגידין runs from where the sinews bunch together until they spread out. In an ox it is four טפחים. In general, sinews that stick out, are hard, thick and white count, and the opposites do not.

phrases.english: Hard ones are the convergence of sinews,
soft ones are not the convergence of sinews,
thick ones are the convergence of sinews,
thin ones are not the convergence of sinews,
white ones are the convergence of sinews,

phrases.aramaic: לָא חִוָּורֵי – לָא הָווּ צוֹמֶת הַגִּידִים.
phrases.english: ones that are not white are not the convergence of sinews.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds more signs to the one given in step 26.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Hard, thick and white sinews are part of צומת הגידין. Soft, thin and non-white ones are not.
